review_notes: I read the whole file. The only repeated machinery I found is inside `Extension.cotangent_finrank_eq_of_formallySmooth`, and nothing nontrivial repeats across separate proofs. The two `hker : _ ≤ maximalIdeal/jacobson` proofs, at about lines 125 and 358, are three-line calculations. A grep of Mathlib found no ready-made `ker_le_maximalIdeal` lemma, so I did not report them. The finding below is a within-proof duplication, so it is weaker than the rubric's "two proofs" wording. It also only removes duplication inside one proof, and I did not check compilation.

findings.problem: The fact `ψ (algebraMap P.Ring B r) = residue P.Ring r` is proved from scratch twice, at lines 148–153 and 181–187. Each proof re-states the long witness `⟨residue P.Ring, by simpa [IsLocalRing.ker_residue] using hker⟩`, and the same witness appears a third time in the definition of `ψ` (line 135) and a fourth in the tower proof (line 142). The scalar-tower proofs at lines 190–199 and 203–214 also repeat the same calc chain: residue-field cast, then `rfl`, then `IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (A := ResidueField B)`. The second block just adds a final step. A change to the choice of `ψ` currently requires editing about five places.
findings.proposed_change: Name the lift hypothesis once, e.g. `have hψres : ∀ r, ψ (algebraMap P.Ring B r) = residue P.Ring r := fun r ↦ RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply (algebraMap P.Ring B) P.algebraMap_surjective ⟨residue P.Ring, _⟩ r`. Use it in the tower at line 151 and in `hr` at line 185. Then state once `have hsmul : ∀ r : P.Ring, (algebraMap P.Ring (ResidueField P.Ring) r) • x = (algebraMap P.Ring B r) • x` for `x : CotangentSpace B`, using the calc at lines 203–214. Derive the `B`-tower at lines 176–199 from it by surjectivity and `hψres`. This leaves one proof of each compatibility fact. The two tower instances become short applications under the same hypotheses (`hker`, `P.algebraMap_surjective`, `IsLocalRing P.Ring`, `IsLocalRing B`).
findings.benefit: The duplicated chain of residue-field coherence steps is proved once and named. A reader can then see which facts the dimension count depends on. Changing how `ψ` is built stops touching four or five places.
